title: Decoding value bounded by game optimum
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with a nonempty label set, let each vertex be assigned a bounded real-valued function on its Boolean cube, and choose a real threshold and a default label. The expected decoding value obtained from the influential coordinates of the table and their neighbor averages is at most the optimum value of the constraint satisfaction instance associated with $G$.
hypotheses_covered: G is a regular unique game
A bounded long-code table is given
A real threshold ε is given
